name: Burn
description: At turn end, target takes fixed damage equal to Burn Potency. Count decreases by 1.

name: Bleed
description: When target rolls coins during attack/clash, takes fixed damage equal to Bleed Potency. Count decreases per coin.

name: Tremor
description: Upon Tremor Burst, pushes target's Stagger threshold forward by Tremor Potency.

name: Rupture
description: Whenever target is hit, deals true damage equal to Rupture Potency. Count decreases by 1 per hit.

name: Sinking
description: On hit, deals SP damage equal to Potency. Deals Gloom HP damage to enemies without SP.

name: Poise
description: Increases Critical Chance by Potency × 5%. Critical hits deal +20% damage.

name: Charge
description: Self-resource count consumed by powerful finisher skills and mechanics.
